objective: Revise a local draft once while retaining each Agent workspace, then approve it.

writer.instructions:
Run the script below with anchor_run using command=["sh","-c",script]. No research. After exit 0, call final_result with summary="draft ready for review", route="reviewer". Run it once per invocation.
set -eu
test ! -e review.txt
if test -e draft.txt; then
  printf 'retained draft:\n'; cat draft.txt
  printf 'retained notes:\n'; cat notes.txt
  printf 'retained effects:\n'; cat effects.txt
  printf 'reviewer input:\n'; cat /in/reviewer/review.txt
  printf 'draft-v1\n' | cmp - draft.txt
  printf 'retained\n' | cmp - notes.txt
  printf 'writer-1\n' | cmp - effects.txt
  printf 'revise once\n' | cmp - /in/reviewer/review.txt
  printf 'retained files and reviewer input verified\n'
  printf 'draft-v2\n' > draft.txt
  printf 'writer-2\n' >> effects.txt
else
  test ! -e notes.txt; test ! -e effects.txt
  printf 'draft-v1\n' > draft.txt
  printf 'retained\n' > notes.txt
  printf 'writer-1\n' > effects.txt
fi
printf 'draft:\n'; cat draft.txt
printf 'notes:\n'; cat notes.txt
printf 'effects:\n'; cat effects.txt

reviewer.instructions:
Run the script below with anchor_run using command=["sh","-c",script]. No research. After exit 0, call final_result: if output says route=writer, summary="revise once", route="writer"; if route=done, summary="approved", route="done". Run it once per invocation.
set -eu
test ! -e draft.txt; test ! -e notes.txt
printf 'writer input:\n'; cat /in/writer/draft.txt
if test -e review.txt; then
  printf 'retained review:\n'; cat review.txt
  printf 'retained effects:\n'; cat effects.txt
  printf 'revise once\n' | cmp - review.txt
  printf 'reviewer-1\n' | cmp - effects.txt
  printf 'draft-v2\n' | cmp - /in/writer/draft.txt
  printf 'retained review and revised draft verified\n'
  printf 'approved\n' > review.txt
  printf 'reviewer-2\n' >> effects.txt
  printf 'route=done\n'
else
  test ! -e effects.txt
  printf 'draft-v1\n' | cmp - /in/writer/draft.txt
  printf 'first draft verified\n'
  printf 'revise once\n' > review.txt
  printf 'reviewer-1\n' > effects.txt
  printf 'route=writer\n'
fi
printf 'review:\n'; cat review.txt
printf 'effects:\n'; cat effects.txt

done.run:
sh -c 'set -eu; printf "writer input:
"; cat /in/writer/draft.txt; printf "draft-v2
" | cmp - /in/writer/draft.txt; cp /in/writer/draft.txt final.txt; printf "final draft verified:
"; cat final.txt'
